selector.rationale: Recurrent abdominal pain and syncope after drinking alcohol, with ECG findings of high-degree atrioventricular block, premature ventricular contractions, and ST segment elevations, are consistent with alcohol-induced Prinzmetal variant angina.

rejected.label: Alcoholic Cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: Lack of specific findings on physical examination and no significant coronary stenosis

rejected.label: Alcohol-Induced Arrhythmias
rejected.why: While arrhythmias are present, they are not the primary diagnosis

rejected.label: Obstructive Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: No evidence of hypertrophy or obstruction in the coronary angiography results

rejected.label: Atrioventricular Block
rejected.why: While present, it is not the primary diagnosis

rejected.label: Variant Angina
rejected.why: While some findings are consistent with variant angina, the alcohol-induced component and other symptoms point more towards alcohol-induced Prinzmetal variant angina
